lint.template: Run the linter for this project. Determine the correct lint command by checking project config (package.json scripts, Makefile, pyproject.toml, etc.). Report all warnings and errors.

test.template: Run the test suite for this project. Determine the correct test command by checking project config (package.json scripts, Makefile, pyproject.toml, etc.). Report all failures.

build.template: Build the project. Check the project config for the correct build command. Create a manifest.scm if needed, then run the build. Report any errors.

typecheck.template: Run the type checker for this project. Determine the correct command by checking project config (package.json scripts, tsconfig.json, pyproject.toml, etc.). Report all type errors.
